ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that uses parameterized quantum circuits to classify user queries before hitting heavy LLM backends.
ideas.title: Qiskit Hybrid QML Semantic Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines Qiskit quantum computing with the proven self-improving semantic routing pattern, directly matching the hackathon's Qiskit and QML focus.

ideas.pitch: An RL agent trained using Qiskit Runtime primitives to dynamically select error mitigation strategies for noisy intermediate-scale quantum circuits.
ideas.title: Quantum Error Mitigation with Reinforcement Learning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves genuine hardware limitations in quantum computing, ticking the hard engineering pattern which judges heavily favor.

ideas.pitch: Two competing Qiskit agents where one generates noisy quantum circuits and the other attempts to optimize and correct them autonomously.
ideas.title: Adversarial Quantum Circuit Generation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning adversarial agent pattern, applying game-theoretic agent behavior to quantum circuit optimization.

ideas.pitch: An automated toolkit that transforms classical graph datasets into quantum state vectors for faster kernel-based machine learning inside Qiskit.
ideas.title: Qiskit-Native Graph Embedding Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles one of the 100 problem statements by providing a reusable data-processing utility tailored for QML pipelines.

ideas.pitch: An agentic workflow tool that translates business process diagrams into QUBO problems to solve resource allocation bottlenecks using QAOA via Qiskit.
ideas.title: Quantum-Assisted BPMN Workflow Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges enterprise business process management with cutting-edge quantum optimization, satisfying the practical problem-solving evaluation criteria.
